Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

When making an Autofire (Machine Pistol 4) attack, you can drop to Machine Pistol 3 to also target a second enemy within 8m/yds of the first, at no extra ammo or Action. Roll each Autofire check separately, both at -2.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
